items: The treehouse has a balcony and a hub: fly straight onto the balcony at treetop height to land, walk into the round room behind it with the world map pouring into its pool, and walk off the balcony's open edge to fly again.
The camera pushes in while she's in the house, and a knockout brings her back at the magic circle behind the decks: she rises out of its floor and walks to her decks to scratch.
